Reading A fails: in 5.2 a structure type's predefined default mapper maps each structure element tofrom, so the allocatable component q is mapped with its storage. dr is implicitly tofrom (not a scalar), ib and ic likewise. Reading B's j concern is moot because Fortran loop iteration variables inside teams constructs are private, and r1b has a max reduction.
